name: LinkedIn Job Postings (2023 - 2024)
notes: No Malaysian postings exist in this dataset (0 found); region set to Global as agreed with the team, but almost all postings are in the United States, so demand reflects the US job market. Only English-language LinkedIn ads posted online, mostly listed in April 2024 (a 4-week snapshot). Exact duplicates (same title + description) removed; near-duplicates and reposts may remain. Roles assigned by title keywords only (one role per posting); see DATA_README.md for the keywords. Skills counted by whole-word keyword matching in the description; a mention does not always mean a requirement (e.g. 'nice to have', company boilerplate). Low-sample roles (<30 postings): none. Roles left out (0 postings): none. Derived from a CC BY-SA 4.0 dataset: give attribution and share these derived files under CC BY-SA 4.0.
